title: Lancet publishes first adjusted national suicide rates for China (1995-99)
description: Phillips, Li & Zhang: 23/100k (~287,000 deaths/yr) after adjusting for unreported deaths; rural 3x urban; baseline for China's later decline to WHO-estimated 8.75 by 2019.

title: Russia implements 2006 alcohol control policy
description: Later attributed an immediate, permanent ~9% reduction in male suicide mortality (~4,000 male lives/yr) — part of Russia's decline from among the world's highest rates.

title: Third wave of opioid epidemic begins (illicit fentanyl)
description: CDC dates the third wave of opioid overdose deaths to 2013, driven by illicitly manufactured fentanyl (see W4 c09 source).

title: India passes Mental Healthcare Act 2017, decriminalizing attempted suicide
description: In force 2018-05-29; presumption of severe stress supersedes IPC 309 — directly relevant to India's police-report undercount.

title: CDC Vital Signs: suicide rates rising across the US
description: MMWR reports suicide rates rose ~30% since 1999, with significant increases in 44 states and >30% increases in 25 states (1999-2016).

title: England & Wales lower coroners' standard of proof for suicide conclusions
description: Threshold moved to 'balance of probabilities'; intentional self-harm coding rose while undetermined intent fell — a natural experiment in how legal process shapes suicide statistics.

title: WHO releases 'Suicide worldwide in 2019: Global Health Estimates'
description: WHO reports >700,000 suicide deaths in 2019 (1 in 100 deaths), a 36% decline in the global age-standardized rate 2000-2019, declines in five regions, and a 17% rise in the Region of the Americas.

title: US Surgeon General advisory: Protecting Youth Mental Health
description: Rare public health advisory declaring a youth mental health crisis accelerated by the pandemic.

title: WHO: pandemic triggered 25% increase in global anxiety and depression
description: WHO scientific brief estimates global prevalence of anxiety and depression rose 25% in the first pandemic year.

title: US launches 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
description: The National Suicide Prevention Lifeline transitions to the three-digit 988 number for 24/7 crisis care nationwide.

title: FDA announces nationwide Adderall shortage
description: Shortage of IR amphetamine mixed salts, citing Teva manufacturing delays and demand outstripping supply — start of multi-year ADHD-drug shortage.

title: CDC MMWR: stimulant prescription-fill trends
description: Fills rose 3.6% (2016) -> 4.1% (2021) of commercially insured, double-digit 2020-2021 jumps among adult women, linked to telehealth-era prescribing.

title: BMJ Oncology publishes global early-onset cancer study
description: GBD-based analysis: early-onset (under-50) cancer cases rose 79% worldwide 1990-2019, to 3.26 million.

title: Pediatrics: youth antidepressant dispensing surged post-March 2020
description: Dispensing to adolescents/young adults rose 63.5% faster after March 2020 than pre-pandemic trend (Chua et al.).

title: NCHS confirms 2022 as record year for US suicide
description: NCHS Data Brief 509 reports 49,476 suicide deaths in 2022 and an age-adjusted rate of 14.2 — the highest since 1941 — up 30% from 2002.

title: FDA approves Cobenfy (xanomeline + trospium) for schizophrenia
description: First antipsychotic targeting cholinergic rather than dopamine receptors — 'the first new approach to schizophrenia treatment in decades' (FDA).

title: DEA releases IQVIA report on US stimulant trends 2012-2023
description: Prescriptions +60% (50.4m -> 80.8m); women overtook men for the first time in 2022-23.

title: CDC announces ~24% decline in US overdose deaths
description: Provisional data (12 months ending Sept 2024): ~87,000 overdose deaths, ~27,000 fewer than prior year.

title: NHSBSA publishes 2024/25 Medicines Used in Mental Health statistics
description: Record 92.6m antidepressant items; +24.3% one-year rise in adults prescribed ADHD medication; items and patients rose in 4 of 5 drug groups.

title: SAMHSA releases 2024 NSDUH
description: Adolescent past-year MDE fell to 15.4% from 18.1% in 2023; adult any-mental-illness roughly stable at 23.4%.

title: NCHS: 2023 US suicide rate essentially unchanged
description: NCHS Data Brief 541 reports 49,316 deaths and a rate of 14.1 in 2023 (-0.7% vs 2022, not statistically significant).

title: NCHS: US life expectancy hits 79.0; 2024 overdose deaths fell 26.2%
description: Data Brief 548: life expectancy +0.6 yr to 79.0, surpassing pre-pandemic. Data Brief 549: final 2024 overdose deaths 79,384.

title: ACS publishes Cancer Statistics 2026
description: Projects 2,114,850 new US cases and 626,140 deaths in 2026; mortality down 34% since 1991; 5-year survival 70%.

title: Final 2024 US mortality data: suicide rate declines
description: NCHS Data Brief 548 reports the 2024 age-adjusted suicide rate fell 2.8% to 13.7 (48,824 deaths); suicide replaced COVID-19 as the 10th leading cause of death.

title: NCHS: overdose deaths fall for third consecutive year
description: Provisional 2025: 69,973 US overdose deaths, ~14% below 2024, declines across opioids, cocaine, psychostimulants.
